name: ultimate-seo-geo
cost: Free. Optional API keys for PageSpeed and extensions
works_with: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Aider, Devin and other AGENTS.md tools
short: An SEO and AI-search skill that audits a site, scores it, plans the fixes and writes them, from schema to robots.txt.
what: A skill for visibility in Google and in AI search tools such as AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search and Perplexity. Give it a URL and it runs an audit with a 0 to 100 health score, turns the findings into a phased plan, then writes fixes like JSON-LD schema, meta rewrites, redirect maps and robots.txt. Bundled Python scripts run the checks and export HTML, Excel and PDF reports.
who: Developers, founders and marketers using a coding agent who want scripted SEO checks plus fixes. It doesn't cover paid ads, social media or writing full articles.
needs: Python 3.8 or later and the packages in requirements.txt
Optional: API keys for PageSpeed, and for extensions such as Firecrawl or DataForSEO

steps.title: Or for any AGENTS.md tool
steps.text: Clone it, then open the folder in your tool.
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/mykpono/ultimate-seo-geo.git
cd ultimate-seo-geo
pip install -r requirements.txt

steps.title: Update the Claude Code plugin
steps.text: Claude Code doesn't pull new releases on its own. Restart the session afterwards.

try.label: From the README
try.text:
Generate the complete schema markup for my SaaS product page at app.example.com

Or: "How do I get cited by ChatGPT and Perplexity for our core product keywords?"

watch: The report script fetches pages from the target site. `--crawl-deep` covers more but is slower and puts more load on the host.
By default many checks use the seed URL with modest crawl limits, so it isn't a full-site crawl.
On Homebrew Python (PEP 668), install the requirements into a virtual environment first.
The Claude desktop app doesn't load skills from `~/.claude/skills`. Upload SKILL.md to a Project instead.
